title: ScrubHandle
description: Horizontal drag handle for scrubbing a numeric value. Typically placed inside a field prefix (W, H, R). Emits onscrub while the pointer moves.

value.description: Current numeric value used as the scrub starting point.

step.description: Multiplier applied to horizontal pixel delta (pixels × step).

min.description: Lower clamp for the scrubbed value.

disabled.description: When true, pointer interactions are ignored.

onscrub.description: Callback (next: number) => void invoked on each pointer move during a drag.

children.description: Snippet rendered inside the handle (usually a short prefix label).
